title: World in Brief
coverage_note: A verified morning snapshot, not a claim that the whole news day has finished.

headline: TRUMP, XI
& PUTIN
AT APEC
stories.verified_claim: Trump, Xi and Putin appeared in the APEC leaders' group photo in Shenzhen on the morning of 19 November, China time.
stories.not_claimed: No trilateral outcome, agreement, completed meeting or future event is asserted.
stories.date_basis: Event on 19 November in Shenzhen, UTC+08:00; Reuters and independent video reporting appeared before the edition cutoff.

headline: CRIMEAN BRIDGE
CLOSURE REPORTED
stories.verified_claim: Crimea's Russian-installed governor announced a temporary suspension of bridge traffic after an attack; the report remains attributed to that official.
stories.not_claimed: No independently confirmed perpetrator, new damage assessment or current reopening status is asserted.
stories.date_basis: Announcement at 01:35 UTC+03:00 on 19 November; also 00:35 in Kyiv. The UTC date was still 18 November.

headline: CYCLONE AKVAN
NEARS INDIA
stories.verified_claim: India's weather agency tracked severe cyclonic storm Akvan northward in the Bay of Bengal in a 19 November observation and warned parts of the coast.
stories.not_claimed: Landfall is explicitly a forecast, not an event that has already happened; no casualty or damage total is given.
stories.date_basis: IMD observation at 02:30 IST and national bulletin issued at 05:30 IST on 19 November.

stories.label: AUSTRALIA JOBLESS RATE
stories.verified_claim: The ABS released the seasonally adjusted October unemployment rate of 4.9% on 19 November at 11:30 AEDT.
stories.not_claimed: The rate describes October data, not one day's layoffs; seasonally adjusted and trend rates are not mixed.
stories.date_basis: New official statistical release on 19 November at 11:30 AEDT, or 00:30 UTC.

headline: GTA VI
stories.label: ROLLOUT BEGINS
stories.verified_claim: Regional digital access to Grand Theft Auto VI began at local midnight on 19 November, including New Zealand and India.
stories.not_claimed: No claim is made that launch has finished worldwide, or that an exact sales or revenue total is confirmed.
stories.date_basis: Observed access in New Zealand and India at local midnight on 19 November, supported by reporting beyond the previously announced schedule.

headline: M5.7
stories.label: KUMAMOTO QUAKE
stories.verified_claim: JMA recorded a new Kumamoto earthquake at 02:22 JST on 19 November with a preliminary magnitude of 5.7.
stories.not_claimed: Magnitude is not confused with the separate Japanese intensity scale. No unverified casualty or damage count is asserted.
stories.date_basis: New earthquake at 02:22 JST on 19 November, or 17:22 UTC on 18 November; the July earthquake in the same sequence is background, not today's event.
